Specification: This module specifies a tiny simulation driver that runs an external TLC simulation command for another specification, apparently SIMccfraft, using the IOUtils community module. The state consists of a configuration record-like function c over fields R, C, Q, and T, each chosen from the set {10, 1000}, and a Boolean flag d that ensures the external command is executed at most once. The behavior initializes c to one of the allowed parameter combinations and d to FALSE, then Next performs a single step that prints the chosen configuration, executes the shell command built by CmdLine, requires the process exit value to be 0, sets d to TRUE, and leaves c unchanged; deadlock checking is disabled in the configuration block.
